digests.subject: AndresL230
digests.summary: Shipped: My Work cards read from structured summaries
digests.brief: Each card on My Work now shows what a pull request changed, why and its impact as separate lines, so a teammate can read a week of work at a glance.
digests.body:
**What** My Work renders each merged pull request from its structured summary: a title, what changed, why and the impact.
**Why** The old cards parsed a prose summary with a pattern that broke on unusual wording.
**Impact** Everyone reading My Work sees the same four parts on every card.

**What** Captured pull request events keep their base branch, and issue events keep their milestone.
**Impact** My Work and the Repo screen can tell a merge to main from a merge between branches.
